name: Ultimate English Guide
author: Artori

notes: Build 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@ immediatly, +1f, +3g, first built gvill builds @building_economy/house.png@@building_economy/mining-camp.png@ at @resource/resource_gold.png@
After 7f 3g build 4 on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@. Here, you can either go aggresion, or fast @age/age_3.png@ path

With 3 @resource/sheep.webp@ vills build @landmark_english/council-hall.png@, in aggression style they are going to f after, in FC - on gold. After that, build +1f and construct @building_economy/mill.png@ to get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@

(AGGRO) continue rally on w, build 2 @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@ and go harass against non-cav civs (defend if @civilization_flag/fre.png@@civilization_flag/jda.png@@civilization_flag/mon.png@@civilization_flag/rus.png@). Get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@, build @building_military/barracks.png@. Hire around 3@unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@ and 5@unit_english/longbowman-2.png@ for initial push, then non-stop harass their food>wood>stone>gold

Build a @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ approximately at 6:45 minute mark for @technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@,@technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@ and @technology_military/siege-engineering.png@. Build another @building_military/barracks.png@, start to add @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@ at some point and send some men to g
(optional) bring 2 vills to build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ at enemy base
(FC) after 7f 4w 3g in @age/age_1.webp@, start to rally on f
Start ralling onto w to build  @building_military/stable.webp@ and @building_religious/monastery.png@. Get map control with @unit_cavalry/knight-2.png@ and collect @resource/relics.png@

description: My own approach on English, based on BeastyQT s5 English guide. I will describe Feudal all-in and FC styles here in one BO (f-food, w-wood, g-gold, s-stone)
